title: Who made the kitties
summary: She cannot recall the piano player who made kitties in Los Angeles.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You mentioned, when you were telling me about kitties, which was all new to me, that they actually looked like kitties, when you arrived in Los Angeles, the custom of having a kitty.
Oh, the cat, yes, for the tip?
Yeah. You said there was one man here
in L.A. who made them. Do you remember who he was?
Uh -- isn't that funny? He was a piano player. I should have made notes, Pat. I should have taken notes. Isn't that funny?
